purpose: Orient the seven figurines left along the bottom straight for clockwise racing; preserve the approved board composition.

Keep each individual figurine's same color, size, material and scale, same base location and spacing. Left-to-right color order must remain white, black, pink, blue, yellow, green, orange. Do NOT reverse color order or mirror the board. Do NOT move any bases or change any other object. Keep precisely seven horses. Preserve the EXACT lane shape, all blank ivory lane surfaces without lines or numbers, all infield decoration and empty payout panel, podium, border trim, all seven card/chip recesses, camera, framing, image dimensions, shadows, background and lighting. Do not add text, labels, numbers, checkpoint, arrows or finish stripe: these are supplied separately as live vector overlays. Preserve the exact pixel alignment of the existing board. Change only the horses' orientation to face LEFT.
